title.rendered: Punch Health Xplainer: Ebola cases are rising again: should Nigerians be worried?

content.rendered:
Recent Ebola outbreaks in parts of Central and East Africa have brought renewed attention to a disease that many people associate with fear and uncertainty. Ebola is a serious viral illness spread through direct contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person, but it is not airborne.

While the current outbreak has raised concerns among health authorities, it remains concentrated in affected areas, with no sustained transmission reported in Nigeria.

excerpt.rendered: Ebola cases are rising in Africa. Learn about the current Ebola outbreak, its spread, and why Nigerians should or shouldn’t be worried.
